description: PAMHD solves ideal magnetohydrodynamics on a Cartesian grid with configurable initial and boundary conditions. The CCMC configuration supports fluid-plasma calculations in one to three dimensions. The resource is documented by Finiish Meteorological Institute. The documented physical domain is Magnetosphere / Global Magnetosphere, Local Physics; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request, Public Repository. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The hosted version excludes the particle-in-cell feature under development and is unsuitable where kinetic effects dominate. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue.
